messages:
leigh: quick note: CI flagged sampleapp import failures after today's SDK release (semver went 0.9.4 -> 0.10.0). regendiff shows only a small signature change but it breaks Go and Java samples.

parker: can you paste the diff/log?

leigh: key snippet from regendiff: 
```
- func UpdateUser(ctx context.Context, id string, opts *UpdateUserOptions) error
+ func UpdateUser(id string, opts *UpdateUserOptions, ctx context.Context) error
```
sampleapp imports fail because positional arg ordering changed for generated clients.

mina: also noticed our release PR didn't include a changelog entry for the bumped package. release automation allowed the bump without CHANGELOG.md update.

regendiff-bot: regendiff queued (run#4801) — diff 9 lines.

parker: why did the comparator mark this as a minor? reordering in positional languages should be breaking. the comparator currently treats parameter reorder as compatible; need language-aware rules.

leigh: plus, the same release included a config tweak: default RetryOnAuthFailure toggled off. that caused onboarding tests to fail (401s not retried). two unrelated changes landed together.

mina: suggested immediate actions: 1) publish hotfix patch restoring retry default (patch 0.10.1), 2) revert generator reordering for positional languages and ship a patch, 3) add presubmit gate: run sampleapp builds for Java/Go/TS against generated SDKs before merging release PRs, 4) make changelog entry mandatory for any public semver bump.

parker: I'll open hotfix PR for retry default. also filing TYPEGEN-451 to add language-aware comparator tests.

regendiff-bot: regendiff result: sampleapp import fails reproduced. https://ci.internal/regendiff/4801

mina: I'll add a changelog linter to the release workflow and a small script `scripts/verify-sampleapps.sh` that builds each sampleapp against generated artifacts. put it in devex repo.

leigh: opened PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1901 (hotfix: retry default), https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1902 (go/java generator revert). CI running.

parker: long-term: release automation should refuse auto-bumps when the diff touches both codegen outputs and runtime config files. bundling different concerns caused this mess.

mina: created DEVEX-678 for gating work and TYPEGEN-451 for comparator. adding a tiny doc note to sampleapp README to `npm i @redwood/sdk@latest` and run `./scripts/validate.sh` to detect API drift earlier.

leigh: CI green on hotfix branch. publishing patch now. will follow-up with postmortem and link to these tickets. :white_check_mark:
